newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Oct 11-12 diesel, jet fuel.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Oct 11-12 diesel, jet fuel.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for October 11-12 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 160,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel. It will close on September 18 and offers will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 145,000 barrels of diesel from Caltex at a premium of around $1.77 per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, on a c-and-f basis. The cargo is for September 19-20 delivery.
